# Temple Scroll Column 37 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** 11QT (Cave 11), Col. 37 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**37:1** The city that I shall consecrate, setting My name and My temple in it — it shall be holy and clean.

**37:2** Nothing unclean shall be in it; everything that is in it shall be clean.

**37:3** Everything that enters it shall be clean, and everything that goes out from it shall be clean.

**37:4** All wine that enters it shall be clean; all oil that enters it shall be clean.

**37:5** All food that enters it shall be clean; no unclean food shall be brought into it.

**37:6** The skins of animals slaughtered in it shall be clean, and they may be used for any sacred purpose.

**37:7** You shall not bring into My city the skin of any animal slaughtered outside it — even if it is clean — for it was not slaughtered in My temple city.

**37:8** You shall not defile My city with the skin of any animal that was not slaughtered before Me.

**37:9** As the city is holy, so also must everything in it be holy; as the temple is holy, so must the city that surrounds it be holy.

**37:10** You shall not bring into the city any unclean creature — no unclean beast and no unclean bird.

**37:11** All wine and oil and every food that enters the city shall be clean.

**37:12** You shall not bring the skin of any unclean animal into it, nor shall you work with it in the city.

**37:13** For the city is holy to the LORD your God; I have set My name upon it and My temple in its midst.

**37:14** It shall be holy and clean and pure before Me for all generations.

**37:15** Nothing abominable shall be found in it, for it is the dwelling place of My name.

**37:16** I the LORD am its God; and I shall dwell in it forever.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus follows EMET closely for this column. "Consecrate" preferred over LOGOS's "sanctify" — both are valid, but "consecrate" implies the initial act of setting apart. "Skins" preserved over PNEUMA's "hides" for biblical register. "Abominable" retained over PNEUMA's "detestable."*
